summary.protocol: scene-grouped CV, no scene in both train and test

scope: Fixed16 TRAIN batches, M95 eval forward, ONE same-forward capture. Features per query: final decoder query embedding (256), query position relative to the scene centroid, predicted-mask centroid offset, normalised mask size, max mask logit. No GT is used as a feature; GT is used only to form labels. A scene-grouped 3-layer MLP is trained per fold and evaluated on held-out scenes, so this measures whether the information is present in the head's own input, not memorisation. Feasibility probe only; not a deployable head, and no model, novelty or efficacy admission.
